After the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was captured by his former [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] and locked within the [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)/Legends|Spire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stygeon/Legends|Stygeon]], the members of Maul's [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] '''broke''' into the prison to liberate their leader. The break out was intended by Sidious, with intent to have Maul lead them to his mother, the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]. The event would lead directly into a [[Campaign against the Shadow Collective|war]] between the Shadow Collective and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SonOfDathomir1" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The event appeared in the [[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir|Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir]]'' comic series, written by [[Jeremy Barlow]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="SonOfDathomir1" /> on [[May 21]], [[2014]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/24-765/Star-Wars-Darth-Maul-Son-of-Dathomir-1|text=Star Wars: Darth Maul&mdash;Son of Dathomir #1}}</ref>
